advisory: This record measures what the advisory semantic review cost and what its artifacts returned. A returned probability is a model answer, never an accuracy figure; a question no request asked is counted as not asked, never as a correct negative.

fieldSources.acrossRuns: the sum of the same figure over every run whose artifact carried it; a figure no artifact carried is null and is named in notComputable, and the runs that did carry it are counted beside it
fieldSources.acrossRuns.executionStates: each run artifact's own #execution, counted: a partial, unavailable, cancelled or skipped run is named here rather than reading as completed
fieldSources.acrossRuns.failureCodes: each run artifact's own #failureCode, counted over the runs that carry one
fieldSources.acrossRuns.reviewRounds: dossiers deduplicated by (pull request, head) before summing: a head with both a scan and a verification sidecar is one round, and acrossRuns.reviewRounds.heads names how many distinct heads those are
fieldSources.acrossRuns.wallClockMs: the sum of the runs' own spans, over the runs that recorded one
fieldSources.acrossRuns.repeatedWarnings: the same (ruleId, path) fired on more than one distinct head of one pull request, keyed by repository and pull request number
fieldSources.acrossRuns.evidence.limitationsByText: each run artifact's own #limitations, one entry per distinct text with the number of runs that recorded it
fieldSources.acrossRuns.ruleCoverage.notAskedByRule: the same rule set the coverage figures count, read once for the whole set rather than repeated per run
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signals.byRule: each run artifact's own #signals[].ruleId or an evaluation outcome's #outcomes[].ruleId, counted once per run across the set
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signals.byDisposition: each run artifact's own #signals[].disposition or an evaluation outcome's #outcomes[].disposition, counted once per run across the set; null when no run carried a signal ledger
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signals.runsWithSignalLedger: the runs that carry a signal ledger at all: a scan report or an evaluation outcome; a verification report assesses findings instead
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signals.byFindingDisposition: each verification report's own #findingAssessments[].disposition, counted across the set; null when no run carried a finding ledger
fieldSources.acrossRuns.signalDispositions: the typed dispositions and the dismissed signals, counted once per (pull request, head) however many sidecars that head has, from each matched dossier and from the literal semantic-signal token
fieldSources.acrossRuns.labelledExpectations: the evaluation runner's own #expectedConcernHeld count over the fixtures it ran
fieldSources.skippedArtifacts: artifacts present on disk that the report validator or the dossier reader refused, with its message
fieldSources.runs[]: not published at this detail level: the record was measured with the aggregate detail level, which carries the across-run figures and the gaps; measure again with --detail for one entry per run

sources.note: retained artifacts from earlier work in this checkout, not a controlled experiment; each run is the pipeline run that wrote the artifact
